{{Top|leg}}
'''Bwago Juice''' was a beverage found in [[the galaxy]]. It was one of the drinks available in the beverage dispenser in the [[Rhysode Room]], which was located in the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] intended to present delegates from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] with a possible new home planet that she and her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had discovered. The meeting was interrupted by the arrival of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]], who immediately proceeded to pour himself a glass of bwago juice before remembering to greet the Ithorian guests.<ref name="JK" />
